title: Christmas Eve: Nara deer · Kuromon lunch · Den Den Town, Shinsaibashi and Ame-mura · yakiniku feast · Hikari Renaissance · Midosuji lights · Giraffe Christmas party · Kinryu ramen

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Out the door at 07:05 with passports, ICOCA/Suica topped up and warm layers: it is a long Christmas Eve that ends after 02:30.

stops.name: Konbini breakfast at Kujō station
stops.plan: Grab onigiri, egg sandos and coffee to eat on the train.
stops.transport: Hanshin Namba line from Kujō, through-running on Kintetsu to Kintetsu-Nara (no change), then walk to Nara Park

stops.name: Nara Park (deer)
stops.plan: Buy deer crackers and get bowed at before the tour buses arrive; keep crackers hidden until you're ready, the deer nip.

stops.name: Todai-ji (Great Buddha Hall)
stops.plan: The giant bronze Buddha in the huge wooden hall; squeeze through the pillar hole for luck. No tripods or group photos inside.
stops.transport: Walk to Kintetsu-Nara, Kintetsu Nara line to Kintetsu-Nippombashi, walk to Kuromon

stops.name: Kuromon Market
stops.plan: Grazing lunch in pairs: grilled scallops, tuna, wagyu skewers and fruit; set a budget, it adds up.
stops.transport: Walk to Den Den Town, 8 min

stops.name: Den Den Town · Ota Road (Super Potato, Animate, card shops)
stops.plan: Anime, retro games, gachapon and card shops; Suruga-ya's main building is on the same strip.
stops.transport: Walk to Namba, Osaka Metro Midosuji line Namba → Shinsaibashi, about 30 min door to door

stops.name: Shinsaibashi-suji Shopping Street
stops.plan: Drugstore and Daimaru (Pokémon Center DX) run; keep each person's tax-free buys at ¥5,000+ ex-tax on one receipt.
stops.transport: Walk west across Midosuji into Ame-mura, 7 min

stops.name: Amerikamura (Ame-mura) vintage streets around Triangle Park
stops.plan: Start at Kinji (Big Step 2F), then split into fours around Triangle Park's vintage shops; regroup at the park.
stops.transport: Walk to Yotsubashi, Osaka Metro Yotsubashi line Yotsubashi → Nishi-Umeda, walk to Ohatsutenjin, about 24 min

stops.name: Yakiniku Rikimaru Umeda Ohatsutenjin
stops.plan: BOOK NOW: Christmas Eve table for 8 at 18:15 (online or 06-6361-3619); all-you-can-eat yakiniku with an all-you-can-drink plan, timed at 90 or 120 min.
stops.price: from about ¥3,300 pp (2023 price) plus drinks plan
stops.transport: Walk south down Midosuji to Nakanoshima, 16 min

stops.name: OSAKA Hikari Renaissance (Nakanoshima)
stops.plan: Christmas Eve lights and the Central Public Hall projection mapping (about 10 min, every 12 min); last entry 21:20. Pick a meeting point, crowds peak tonight.
stops.transport: Walk to Yodoyabashi, Osaka Metro Midosuji line Yodoyabashi → Shinsaibashi, about 25–30 min door to door

stops.name: Midosuji Illumination 2026
stops.plan: Walk the lit ginkgo boulevard south toward Namba at an easy pace, photos on the way; finish at Dotonbori by the club.

stops.name: Giraffe Japan (nightclub)
stops.plan: BOOK: Christmas Eve entry tickets for 8 a few days ahead. In early, before the midnight queue. Original passports, no shorts or sandals.
stops.price: about ¥800–1,800 pp advance foreigner ticket incl. drinks

stops.name: Kinryu Ramen Dotonbori
stops.plan: Post-club tonkotsu under the giant dragon: buy tickets at the machine, help yourselves to the free kimchi and garlic.
stops.transport: Taxi to Kujō House, 2 cars, 16 min with pickup

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Home and sleep; tomorrow starts at 09:00 with the suitcases.
